Traditional cottage craftsmanship

Superior Standard Features

Premium structural details and carefully considered exterior craftsmanship are standard on the Foxfire Cottage.

Foundation & Floor

4×6 pressure-treated foundation beams over 16×16×4-inch concrete support pads; 2×6 pressure-treated floor joists at 16 inches on center and ¾-inch pressure-treated exterior plywood.

Framing & Roof

2×4 kiln-dried wall studs at 16 inches on center, engineered traditional trusses at 24 inches on center, and the distinctive 9/12 main roof profile.

Doors & Windows

Site-built 60×80-inch Craftsman double wood doors with black hardware; two 24×30-inch white aluminum single-hung windows with screens and locks.

Exterior Siding

Roseburg DuraTemp included, with LP SmartSide Vertical, Board & Batten, Lap, and GP Vinyl Lap upgrade options.

Roof & Weather Protection

½-inch CDX roof sheathing, architectural shingles, synthetic underlayment, and ridge vent ventilation where compatible with roof design.

Built on Site

Constructed on your property, with engineered support and anchorage matched to the building and site. Conditions beyond the included 6-inch leveling allowance are quoted separately.

Helpful details

Frequently Asked Questions

Is the Foxfire Cottage built on my property?

Yes. Every Appalachian Sheds building is constructed on site. Property access and placement are reviewed before the written proposal is finalized.

Which siding is included in the starting price?

Roseburg DuraTemp is included. LP SmartSide Vertical Textured Panel, Board & Batten, LP Lap and GP Vinyl Lap are available at the listed upgrade prices.

Does the price include a finished interior?

No. Standard pricing is for an exterior weather-tight shell. Insulation, interior walls, ceiling finishes, electrical work and similar improvements are not included unless separately specified.

When does the exterior need finishing?

Required exterior caulking and painting or staining should be completed within 30 days after construction. Appalachian Sheds can quote optional exterior finishing services.

What if my property requires additional preparation?

The written proposal addresses access, drainage, anchoring and site work. Additional leveling or preparation beyond the included 6-inch tolerance is quoted in writing.
